title: A-3000 assembly & design review
registerRevision: 2026-09-10 · Physical equipment ownership and complete Explore assemblies
lead: Vent-gas treatment: the wet-acid train (collection header HD-3100, knock-out drum V-3110, packed caustic scrubber T-3140, mist polishing ME-3150, induced-draft fan FN-3160, stack ST-3170) with its liquor and waste handling (T-3180 / P-3181A-B, NaOH day tank T-3182 / P-3182, makeup TK-3184 / P-3184, condensate TK-3111 / P-3111, blowdown P-3183, control station CP-3000), and the segregated satellite packages — A-700 thermal abatement AB-3701 / ST-3702, A-800 reactive-gas AB-3801 / ST-3802 and the dry-inventory / KBH₄-feeder vent packages DC-3811 / DC-3812.

findings.topic: Vent routing philosophy — three segregated systems
findings.status: Design intent approved — MoC on PFD-3000 required
findings.reason: H₂, O₂ and CO in one header, and potassium vapour into water, are the two failure modes the as-drawn single-header PFD-3000 creates; treatment must match the contaminant and the pressure regime of each source.
findings.observation: D-A3000-01 adopts REP-041 as the design intent: S1 — the wet caustic scrubber on wet vents only (a few hundred to ≈ 1,000 Nm³/h; A-300 quench O₂ ≈ 160 Nm³/h peak); S2 — PY-701 CO / CO₂ / H₂O in argon (4–8 Nm³/h CO steady, ×3–5 in the burst, 8–10 vol %) to a thermal treatment; S3 — PY-801 H₂ in argon (12–35 Nm³/h, 30–55 vol %) with 10–20 kg/h potassium vapour to a hot-end condenser with no water contact. PFD-3000 as drawn routes every vent to one knock-out drum and caustic scrubber; LST-001 lists only the seven wet-train tags. The model already carries the segregated branches AB-3701 and AB-3801 and the two dry packages, and its exhaust-group check confirms they are not accidentally connected. WorkSafeBC Part 5.71 requires separate exhaust where combining combustible sources creates a fire or explosion risk.
findings.action: Raise the MoC on FEED-PFD-3000 for S1 / S2 / S3; add the S2 / S3 packages and the dry-vent packages to LST-001; confirm the segregation in HAZOP and against the actual source duties.

findings.topic: S1 wet-vent source register and sizing basis
findings.status: Basis approved — no source register, nothing sized
findings.reason: The scrubber, fan and stack are sized on the simultaneous peak of the wet sources; without a source register with compositions there is no duty.
findings.observation: D-A3000-01 approves the S1 basis — wet vents only, a few hundred to ≈ 1,000 Nm³/h — and records that A-600 is not an A-3000 load (its own F-601 / SC-601 in the DBM inert closed loop; 333,000 Nm³/h if it were air-swept). The model header HD-3100 collects the A-100 / A-140 / A-160 tank vents, A-200 AV201, A-300, A-500 and the A-600 tank vent as interface records without composition or flow. No source register with simultaneous peaks exists; the model's "candidate wet source register" is a placeholder, and the fan is "VFD proposed" without a duty.
findings.action: Issue the S1 source register (composition, normal and peak flow, simultaneity, pressure limits of each connected vessel), then size V-3110, T-3140, ME-3150, FN-3160 and ST-3170 and qualify the stack height.

findings.topic: S2 and S3 satellite packages — technology and permits
findings.status: Envelopes reserved — technology selection and permit HOLD
findings.reason: A CO-in-argon stream and a hydrogen / potassium stream need their own treatment mechanism, outlet and permit; a caustic absorber does not destroy CO or H₂.
findings.observation: The model reserves AB-3701 (A-700 thermal abatement candidate) with its independent outlet ST-3702 and permissive station CP-3700, and AB-3801 (A-800 specialist reactive-gas package) with ST-3802 / CP-3800; both outlets are "permit HOLD" and their atmospheric interfaces are records only. D-A3000-01 fixes S3 as a hot-end potassium condenser with no water contact and the S3 vent branch to ASME B31.12 (A-800 review); the A-700 and A-800 emergency reliefs (PSV-701, PSV-801) stay independent of treatment. The satellite floor reservation is 23.0 × 2.9 m; package internals and maintenance withdrawal need vendor design.
findings.action: Select the S2 thermal treatment and the S3 condenser / hydrogen handling technology on the re-issued A-700 / A-800 balances; obtain the emissions permits for ST-3702 / ST-3802; fix the vendor envelopes.

findings.reason: Dry inerted inventories breathe argon with fines and, on the KBH₄ side, hydrolysis-sensitive dust; they must not enter the wet train.
findings.observation: The model reserves DC-3811 (dry inventory vent) and DC-3812 (KBH₄ feeder vent) as selection-HOLD packages with positively blinded outlets. The previous review corrected the tags: BL-VENT801 is dry-inventory / mixer breathing, BL-REL801 the A-800 emergency relief outlet, BL-RV701 the A-700 relief. Neither package is on LST-001 and neither has a duty or a material.
findings.action: Define the breathing and dust loads from the A-700 / A-800 inerting basis (D-A6000-01 gas ruling), select the package type, register both and assign their outlets.

findings.topic: Assembled wet train — connections, air gap and liquor handling
findings.status: Geometry checks pass — six interfaces unresolved
findings.reason: An assembled model with every endpoint dispositioned is the basis for the P&ID and for the plant-wide connectivity checks; the makeup-water air gap is a backflow safeguard that must survive detailing.
findings.observation: The revision A3000-45 register dispositions 340 endpoints (connected, positively blinded, intentional discharge, intentional air gap); six interfaces remain unresolved — the fan and stack drain receivers, the two external supplies (water, NaOH) and the two dry-package outlets — all positively blinded in the planning configuration. The proposed 520 mm air gap between the water supply and TK-3184 is intentional and must not be bridged; the V-3110 inlet has been re-aligned with an elbow and a straight approach; six pump adapters match their pipe sizes. The checks are re-run for this revision (see recorded checks). Liquor handling — T-3180 with duty / standby P-3181A / B, NaOH day tank T-3182 / P-3182, makeup TK-3184 / P-3184, sealed condensate receiver TK-3111 / P-3111 and controlled blowdown P-3183 — is modelled, but overflow, bypass and blowdown destinations are records only and the drain-seal, receiver-capacity and disposal acceptance remain HOLD.
findings.action: Keep the air gap through detailing (final flood level, splash control, overflow duty); assign the fan / stack drain receivers, the water and NaOH supplies and the blowdown, overflow and bypass destinations on the P&ID; carry the A3000-45 register into the P&ID line list.

findings.status: Ruled for the register train — model-only items uncovered
findings.reason: Wet acid gas with caustic liquor sets FRP after the cooling / wetting point and alloy on the hot, dry inlet side.
findings.observation: D-A3000-MOC applies MAT-002 to the seven register items: vinyl-ester-novolac FRP after cooling / wetting, PP / PVDF packing and demister, 316L or Alloy 601 / 602 CA on the hot / dry sections; MDL-001 (HDPE / XLPE liquor tank, PVDF / PFA-lined pumps) superseded. The model-only items — T-3182, P-3182, ME-3150, TK-3111, P-3111, P-3183, TK-3184, P-3184, HD-3100, CP-3000 and the six satellite items — have neither a register identity nor a material.
findings.action: Extend MAT-002 to the model-only wet-train items once they are registered — the A-3000 datasheets propose PVDF sealless pumps, a PVDF / PTFE metering head, a 316L make-up pump, FRP TK-3111 and HDPE T-3182 / TK-3184 (A3000-08); specify the S2 / S3 package materials with the technology selection (S3 to ASME B31.12).

findings.topic: Register and model reconciliation, stack and emissions
findings.status: Register reconciliation required — emissions acceptance open
findings.reason: Every item in the area must have one identity in the register, the model and the data layer; the stack and outlets need emissions acceptance before any operating release.
findings.observation: LST-001 lists seven A-3000 tags (V-3110, T-3140, T-3180, P-3181A / B, FN-3160, ST-3170); the model owns 27 items including ten wet-train auxiliaries, the six satellite items, the two dry packages, fire point FE-3001 and emergency station ES-3000. ST-3170's height is unqualified; the atmospheric outlets (ST-3170, ST-3702, ST-3802) have no emissions basis. The operating release remains HOLD: gas composition, simultaneous peak loads, pressure limits, vendor selection and emissions acceptance are still required.
findings.action: Register the model-only items on LST-001 or record them as proposed by decision; qualify the stack heights and the emissions basis for the three outlets with the permit; keep the operating release on HOLD until the source register and vendor designs exist.

findings.topic: Equipment datasheets — S1 scrubber liquid side
findings.status: Preliminary datasheets issued — candidate values, none approved
findings.reason: REP-041 fixes the S1 gas side but none of the liquor-side equipment had a flow, head, volume, design condition or (for the model-only auxiliaries) a material.
findings.observation: FEED-PE-CAL-017 V1.0 sizes the S1 liquid side on the bases approved in review (F1 1,000 Nm³/h design gas, 0.8 m column at 0.61 m/s, 15 m³/m²·h irrigation → 7.5 m³/h recirculation; F2 25 wt % NaOH from IBCs at 1.5 kg/h NaOH design against ≤ 1.3 kg/h required; F3 blowdown ≈ 40 kg/h at 5 wt % salts plus up to 49 kg/h of condensed water, and the knock-out condensate, batch-pumped to A-1000; F4 proposed materials), with NPSH available and system curves from the start. Datasheets FEED-PE-DAT-030…038 carry it — P-3181A/B 8.5 m³/h at 13 m (NPSHa 9.3 m), T-3180 1.5 / 3.0 m³, P-3182 0–10 L/h at 3 barg, T-3182 0.85 / 1.0 m³ (≈ 7.5 days), P-3183 and P-3111 1 m³/h at 10 m, TK-3111 1.2 / 1.5 m³, TK-3184 0.4 / 0.5 m³, P-3184 1.5 m³/h at 20 m. They enter as 205 candidate rows — none approved; every A-3000 missing-value gap now has a source, and the proposed materials do not contest the approved D-A3000-MOC rows.
findings.action: Close the holds — the re-derived HCl load (REP-037), the S1 source register and O₂ vent profile (A3000-02), PP-packing O₂ compatibility, routing, the electrical basis and the A-1000 receiving points — register the model-only auxiliaries (A3000-07), extend MAT-002, then approve the sizing values by decision.

decisions.rationale: Plant-wide ruling: FEED-PE-MAT-002 'Recommended MOC (base case)' governs material of construction over FEED-PE-MDL-001 (scale-up study) and design-note wording — MAT-002 is the controlled MoC matrix and postdates MDL-001. Wording variants of the same material family are superseded by the MAT-002 statement.
REP-041 segregation adopted as design intent: S1 wet caustic scrubber on wet vents only (a few hundred to ≈ 1,000 Nm³/h); furnace gases excluded.
decisions.gapNote: MoC on FEED-PFD-3000: three segregated vent systems S1 (wet, caustic scrubber) / S2 (PY-701 CO-in-argon, thermal oxidiser) / S3 (PY-801 H₂/K-in-argon, hot-end K condenser, ASME B31.12); add S2 / S3 to LST-001 (the model's A-3700 branch already exists); confirm in HAZOP.

decisions.rationale: S2 — PY-701 CO/CO₂/H₂O-in-argon treated separately (model branch AB-3701).
S3 — PY-801 H₂-in-argon with potassium vapour: hot-end condenser, no water contact (model branch AB-3801).
H₂ + O₂ + CO in one header and K into water are the failure modes the as-drawn PFD-3000 creates — segregation is the safeguard intent.
A-600 is not an A-3000 load (own F-601 / SC-601; DBM inert closed loop); S1 sized on wet vents only.
